items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: It was Toodlam. It was Aaron Harris. It was Frenchy. Oh. Oh, there was Johnny Ray. There was Tom Leon. I mean, these were bad boys.

ctx.x: I want to hear a bad man about it. I want to see if you're going to talk about Aaron Harris. Yeah. Yeah. Well, it's not one of you. It's not on this. Yeah. It's Aaron.

That was a bad boy. Did you? I knew him. Yeah. You knew him too, huh? Oh, yeah. I knew him. What do you think they're talking about? It was Toodlam. It was Aaron Harris. It was Frenchy. Oh. Oh, there was Johnny Ray. There was Tom Leon. I mean, these were bad boys. You see, when the cop wanted Aaron, they wouldn't take him up like they'd pick up nobody. They'd tell him the chief want to see him. I'll be there tomorrow, tell him. They tricked him out of his life, you see. Yeah, I agree. Yeah, they tricked him out…
